quiz_title: Web Design - Quiz 2: Media & Interactive Forms

questions.q: Which attribute displays play/pause controls on a native HTML5 video player?
questions.exp: The 'controls' attribute adds play, pause, volume, and full-screen controls to the audio or video element!

questions.q: Which input type displays a color picker widget on modern browsers?
questions.exp: Setting type="color" creates a magic color wheel where users can pick colors!

questions.q: Which element groups related fields inside a form with a nice visual border?
questions.exp: The <fieldset> element draws a box outline around inputs, while <legend> adds a title label!

questions.q: What attribute makes a form input field mandatory to fill out?
questions.exp: Adding the 'required' attribute prevents form submission until the user types inside that field!

questions.q: Which tag creates a drop-down selection menu in HTML?
questions.exp: The <select> tag creates the drop-down menu container, which holds <option> tags!
